pr.title: feat(rte): structured_output_contracts service_tier + cache directives + anthropic_tool_use variant (E3)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Extends `route_entries_for_stage()` to surface `service_tier` from per-route metadata so the LLM call path can pass it through to OpenAI/OpenRouter.
- Adds `prompt_caching_directives_for_provider(provider, model_id, prompt_text_lengths)` returning provider-appropriate cache markers: Anthropic `cache_control` annotations, OpenAI `prompt_cache_key`, Gemini cached-content references.
- Adds a fourth schema variant `anthropic_tool_use` to `provider_schema_variant()` so Claude routes serving CE/strict cells receive a tool_use-shaped schema rather than being treated as 'canonical' (which Anthropic doesn't honor as strict).

## Scope
Limited to `lib/structured_output_contracts.py` and three new unit-test files. No changes to pricing.yaml, spend_ledger, llm_runtime, batch_clients, run_extraction_v5, or model_map.yaml.

## Validation
New tests cover: service_tier pass-through, cache-directive generation per provider, anthropic_tool_use variant selection, and verification that the three existing variants (canonical / xai_relaxed / gemini_relaxed) are byte-identical for non-Anthropic providers. Existing strictness + provider-modes tests remain green.

## NOT_RUN
- Live LLM calls (RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 enforced).
- Cross-packet integration (covered by F verification packet).

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- Anthropic tool_use schema shape requires real Claude response validation; first live run with the new variant should compare outputs against the pre-variant baseline.

steps.task: Add `prompt_caching_directives_for_provider(provider, model_id, prompt_text_lengths=None, *, cache_strategy='auto')` returning a dict like `{'cache_control_markers': [...], 'prompt_cache_key': '...', 'cached_content_name': '...', 'applied': True|False, 'strategy': 'auto'|'cache_control_explicit'|'none'}`. Anthropic gets cache_control on the last ~3 message blocks per Anthropic best practice (long stable prefix + small mutable tail); OpenAI gets prompt_cache_key derived from a stable hash of the system+message prefix; Gemini gets cached_content_name only if explicitly enabled (None otherwise — implicit cache is automatic).
